variants.name: trim the wing ends
variants.why: R03.1 front span 1.043 (max 1.03) and the back view's blue excess at the outer wing tips (R04.1): the soft coat stays, only locks whose tip is beyond |x| .20 are shortened further (tip-trim .009 to .020, about .011 per side, aim span about 1.00); one H33 edit so the soft look the readers chose is untouched

variants.name: trim ends, thin the rear base
variants.why: audit rank 5 and the R04 issue: back width at .18 is 1.33x the sheet (R01.6, R04.1 IoU .870) because the lowest rear E locks (LE/RE12 to 14, tips u .09 to .12 at y .17 to .18) and the core and dome swell beside the head base; drop those six locks, pull the core lower edge in (inset .015 to .03) and end the dome at y .160 (from .176); plus the wing-end trim of variant 1 for the span

variants.name: strong rear thin, trim from .17
variants.why: larger move so a reader can see it: also drop LE11 and RE11, rear clumps narrower (width-scale .9 to .8), dome blur 14 to 20, core inset .04, and the wing trim starts at |x| .17 (tip-trim .016) so the whole outer half shortens rather than only the end locks
